connector.name: Robyn - Gasless Cross-Chain for AI Agents
connector.registryDescription: Gasless cross-chain for AI agents: 25 nodes incl. Solana & native Bitcoin. One signature, no gas.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.anygas.xyz over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package anygas-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ox31461 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ROBYN_SVC
env.description: Base URL of the Robyn gateway (gasless quote/route/execute API). Optional — defaults to https://api.anygas.xyz/svc.

env.name: ROBYN_SIGNER_KEY
env.description: Optional hex private key. If set, the server signs and submits gasless intents autonomously; if omitted, it returns unsigned intents for the agent/user to sign.
